verdict.rationale: Viam documents remote access to deployed machines through firewalls via built-in NAT traversal, with no VPN needed. From a browser you can stream camera feeds, read sensor data and visualize machine state in real time, and use test panels to debug without deploying code. GetMachineStatus reports resource health and why a resource fails, and the CLI can call any machine API remotely. Missing for 10: any evidence of remote log viewing or streaming, an explicit topic or message-stream inspection equivalent, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the remote debugging workflow.
